s: Mom: Why you smiled（微笑）happily in the morning?  Daughter: I 　　　 a wonderful（美好的） dream last night.  I 　　　 in a park, the sun was shining（照耀）, and the birds were singing.  It was very peaceful（和平地）.  I didn’t want to wake up.
e: 說明過去某個時間正在進行的動作，持續的動作。was / were 再加上動詞加 ing。S＋was / were＋V-ing。

s: When it 　　　 to rain, we 　　　 the clothes in the balcony（陽臺）.
e: 當雨「開始」下的時候我們「正在」陽臺「晒」衣服。說明過去某個時間正在進行的動作，持續的動作。was / were　再加上動詞加 ing。S＋was / were＋V-ing。

s: Charlie: Why did you look so tired?  　　　 you 　　　 computer games at midnight（半夜）last night?  Fred: No, I wasn’t.
e: was / were 再加上動詞加 ing。S＋was / were＋V-ing。

s:
對話與完成句子
Kim: What happened to my favorite cup? Jamie:
o: I have nothing in the drawer.
You were sleepwalking and broke it.
The fan was on all night.
e: 你昨晚在夢遊時打破了它。Jamie　告訴　Kim　杯子是她夢遊時自己打破的，語意連貫。

s: Mom: Did you clean the living room?  Cindy: Yes.
o: I was sweeping the floor at 7 this morning.
We have no pets at home.
e: Cindy　回答她今天早上七點正在掃地。

s: Eric: Who was using the kitchen at a quarter after one?  Mandy: It’s me.
o: I did the dishes last morning.
e: 那時我正在喝水。Mandy　說明自己當時出現在廚房的原因。

s: Mom: Do you know what happened to this broken cup?  Kim: Yes.
o: We have no trash at home.
e: 有人在晚上打破了它。Kim　回答媽媽，直接針對問題描述發現情況。

s: Ann: Why were you in the kitchen last night?  Ken: What?  I didn’t know it.  Maybe 　　　.
o: I feed my pet every day
I went shopping in the morning
e: 我自己不知道，或許我在夢遊。Ken　解釋當時並非有意進廚房。

s:
Jack: It’s time for lunch! Mom is in the kitchen, right? Jane: No,
　　　.
o: she left at half past eleven
she plays with Lucky every day
she was sleeping at her room
e: 她在十一點半就離開了。Jane　回答媽媽當時不在廚房。

s:
Jacky: What time is it? Is twenty after seven now? Ann: Yes,
　　　.
e: twenty after seven　意為「七點二十分」，與(Ｄ)完全對應。

s:
Ivy: There’s something wrong. I can’t turn on my computer. Ben:
　　　, but nothing happened.
o: I tried to fix it this morning
I am watching a video now
e: 我今天早上試著修理它。Ben　對電腦無法開機作出反應，語意合理自然。

s: Tina: The monitor showed something at 2 a.m.  Bob:
o: Lucky is playing in the park.
e: 又是我在夢遊嗎？Bob　聽到時間後懷疑是自己夢遊畫面，語意連貫。

s: Emma couldn’t sleep well because 　　　.
o: she drank milk in the morning
her friend gave her a dreamcatcher
she was scared of her bad dreams
she finished her homework before bed
e: 她因為惡夢而感到害怕所以睡不好，選(Ｃ)。

s: The dreamcatcher helped Lisa 　　　.
e: 捕夢網幫助她整晚安穩入睡，符合　dreamcatcher　的功能描述。

s: Kelly: The floor looks wet（濕的）.  Daniel: Sorry, I 　　　 it a minute ago.
e: 我剛剛正在擦它。用過去進行式說明剛剛的動作最自然。

s: Sarah: You weren’t close to the table.  Leo: That’s strange.
o: Then how did the cup break?
The drawer is full of clothes.
e: 那杯子怎麼會破？Leo　對現象感到疑惑，表現自然懷疑的語氣。

s: Anna: Er, Dad.  Look at the video.  You sleepwalked and ate my favorite chocolate cake.  Dad: Oh my!  When did it happen?
o: I don’t remember it at all.
e: 由影片看出爸爸夢遊並吃掉　Anna　最愛的巧克力蛋糕。但爸爸表示「我一點也不記得了。」。

s: Ann: What time did you finish your homework last night?  Max:
o: I did it for three hours.
I finished it at half past ten.
I did it two hours ago.
I was doing it at eight last night.
e: Ann　問　Max　幾點完成功課，Max　回答「十點半完成。」。

s: Mom: Wake up!  It’s almost 7:30 a.m. now.  You are late for school.  Leo: 　　　  Today is Saturday.
e: 媽媽叫醒 Leo，因為他上學遲到了。Leo 要媽媽「放輕鬆。」因為今天是星期六。

s: Jim: Is it one to one?  Zoe: Yes.
o: It’s time to have a breakfast.
It’s time to fix the clock again.
e: Jim　詢問　Zoe「現在差　1　分到　1　點嗎？」Zoe　以「是的。是　12　點　59　分。」回應。

s: Diana: Does your husband help you with any work in the house?  Jenny: Of course.
o: He looks for things for me.
He does the dishes after dinner.
He takes a walk with me after dinner.
e: Jenny　的先生當然幫忙她做家事，故選「他晚餐後洗碗盤。」。

s: Hank: What were you doing at home at 8:10 p.m. yesterday?  You did not answer the phone.  Rita: 　　　  And I put my cellphone on the dining table.
o: I was walking in the street.
I was working at the desk in the office.
e: Rita 昨晚　8：10「正在使用廁所」，因此無法接聽電話。

s: Owen: What were they doing at four yesterday afternoon?  Pete:
e: Owen　問「他們昨天下午四點在做什麼？」Pete　回答「他們正在打籃球。」。

s: Liz: Our son did not do his math homework again.  Do something, dear.  Ted: 　　　  Let me talk with him right now.
e: Liz　告知她先生　Ted　他們的兒子又沒做數學功課了，要有所行動啊。Ted　要　Liz「冷靜下來。」他立刻要和兒子交談一下。

s: The monitor was shouting（尖叫） loudly, and I woke up to check it out.  I found（找到） a man was walking in the kitchen.  How scared I was!  When I walked into the kitchen, my little brother 　　　.
o: didn’t go back to sleep again
e: 監視器發出尖叫聲，我起身查看。我發現一名男子在廚房走動，我感到非常的害怕！當我走進廚房時，我弟弟「正在廚房裡夢遊」。

s: Lynn: What were you doing in the living room at seven yesterday evening?  Lydia: 　　　 What a terrible night!  Lynn: Take it easy, Lynn.
o: I broke my grandpa’s monitor.  He was angry at me.
Mom was doing the dishes yesterday evening.
I was drinking some warm milk.
e: Lynn　問　Lydia　昨天晚上在客廳做什麼？Lydia　回應說「我弄壞了爺爺的監視器，爺爺對我很生氣。」。

s: Anna: Were you listening to music at that time?  Lisa:
o: I was listening to music in the room.
I listen to music at ten every night.
I don’t like music at all.
e: Anna　問　Lisa　那時候在聽音樂嗎？是 Yes-No 問句，所以　Lisa　肯定簡答「是呀，我是。」。

s: Lisa: What did you do after ten thirty?  Rick:
o: Yes, I didn’t do many things.
I sweep the floor every day.
e: Lisa　問　Rick　十點半後做了什麼事，Rick　回答「我清理廚房。」。

s: Iris: What was Jay doing in the kitchen at half past twelve a.m.?  Lisa: I knew it!  He was very hungry, and he was eating your chocolate cake.  Iris: That’s right.
o: He was looking at it at dinner.
Let’s not be nice to him next time.
e: Lisa　知道　Jay　凌晨　12：30　在廚房吃掉了　Iris　的巧克力蛋糕。Iris　贊同　Lisa　的說法，她發現「Jay　晚餐時一直注視著它啊！」。所以凌晨　12：30　在廚房偷吃掉它。

s: Linda got up in the middle（在…中間）of the night, because 　　　.  She felt（感覺）hot, so she turned on the fan and went back to sleep.  She could have a nice dream finally.
o: she didn’t get any sleep at all
she found nothing under the sofa
e: Linda 在半夜起來，「因為她睡不好」。她覺得很熱，所以她打開電扇再回去睡覺。最後終於能睡個好覺。

s: Jill: Dear, did you see my money?  Leo: Where did you last see it?  Jill: I don’t remember it at all.  What can we do now?  That’s a lot of money.  Leo: 　　　  Let’s look for it right now.
o: Don’t say it to me again.
How much money do you have?
e: Jill　找不到一大筆錢，不知該怎麼辦？Leo　要她「放輕鬆。」現在要一起尋找它。

s: Mom: Today is Sunday.  Josh, come and help wipe the windows.  Josh: 　　　  I’m coming.
e: 星期天媽媽要　Josh　幫忙擦拭窗子，Josh　以「好的。我就來了。」回應。

s: Meg: Dear, I put the money in our bedroom, but I can’t remember where it is.  Where can it be?  Roy:
o: Don’t look for it.  Just put it there.
All right.  Let me take it out for you.
How can that happen to me again?
Take it easy.  Let’s look for it together.
e: Meg　想不起把錢放在臥室的什麼地方，Roy　要她「放輕鬆。讓我們一起尋找。」。

s: Max: Why weren’t you calling for help when someone was standing by your bed then?  Emi: I cried out, but no sound（聲音）came out.  　　　  Max: Did he do anything（任何事情）bad to you?  Emi: Luckily, he ran out before you came in.
o: I could not speak or move at all.
e: Emi　床邊站著某人時，她喊叫求救，卻沒有聲音發出來。「她根本無法說出話或移動。」幸好　Max　即時進到她房間。

s: Mom was in the kitchen at half past eleven p.m.
o: Why isn’t she feeding our pet dog?
She was just doing the dishes.  Before that, she was watching TV after dinner.
e: 媽媽晚上　11：30　在廚房。「她就只是在洗碗盤。在那之前，她晚餐後一直在看電視。」。

s: Anna: Oh no!  　　　  Pete: Maybe our pet dog Lucky did.  Let’s check the video from the monitor.
o: My cup was fine when I put it on the table.
Who fed the fish in the fish bowl（魚缸）?
Who looked for me all morning?
e: Anna：噢不！「誰打破我最愛的杯子呢？」Pete：或許是寵物狗　Lucky　弄的。要查看監視器錄影帶。

s: Jason: You looked tired and late for work today.  Jimmy: I had a terrible night last night.  I went to bed at half past three, and I couldn’t fall asleep.  Jason: Did you try some ways to fall asleep?  Jimmy: Sure, I exercised and listened to the music.  Jason: Maybe 　　　.  It can help you relax（放鬆）more and fall asleep quickly（快地）.
o: you can watch some ghost movies
you can drink a cup of hot coffee next time
you can go to work next time
you can drink a cup of warm milk next time
e: Jimmy 今天早上看起來很累並且工作遲到了。Jason 建議他下次可以喝些溫牛奶，可以比較放鬆且很快睡著。

s: Mia: How come you were at home at 8 p.m. today?  But you did not open the door for me when I rang（按響）the doorbell（門鈴）.  Ken: Sorry.
o: I wasn’t even close to the front door.
I was taking a shower in the bathroom.
Wasn’t I feeding our pet dog Cody?
Weren’t you opening it with your own key?
e: Ken　今晚　8：00　無法替　Mia　開門，因為「他正在浴室淋浴。」。

s: Dan: I go to bed at thirty after eleven from Monday to Thursday.  Sue: So late?  Dan: That’s right.
o: My bedtime is ten thirty p.m.
That’s why I’m a morning person.
I go to bed at half past eleven four days a week.
e: 「Dan　一週四天　11：30　就寢。」(Ｂ)　a morning person：晨型人(Ｃ) an early sleeper：早睡者。

s: Zoe: Wait!  Can you fix the drawer for me?  Ben: 　　　  I’m good at（擅長）that, you know.
e: Zoe 要 Ben 為她修理抽屜。Ben 以「好的。」回應，並自稱自己很擅長的。

s: When Dad broke Mom’s favorite plate, 　　　.
o: he left it on the dining table
he wasn’t even close to them
e: 當爸爸打破媽媽最愛的盤子時，「他正在洗碗盤」。

s: Maybe our pet dog Cody ate your chicken leg.
o: Let’s watch the video from the dog monitor.
It was him.  I knew it.
e: 「或許」我們的寵物狗　Cody　吃了你的雞腿。「讓我們查看狗狗監視器的錄影帶吧。」。(Ａ)(Ｃ)都已很確定，較不宜作答。

s: At 8:30 p.m. yesterday, 　　　.
o: Mr. Lu’s hanging the clothes for his wife
Mr. Lu was busy taking out the trash
Mr. Lu was making breakfast for his family
Mr. Lu was watching his kids under the blue sky in Taiwan
e: 昨晚　8：30，「Lu　先生正忙著倒垃圾」。(Ａ)　Mr. Lu’s　須改成　Mr. Lu was(Ｃ)至少　breakfast　須改成　dinner(Ｄ)夜晚不會是蔚藍的天空。

s: Mom, don’t be mad at me.  　　　  Let me talk to you about my new boyfriend again.
o: Can’t you be close to me?
e: 說話者要媽媽不要生氣。「冷靜一下。」要再跟她談一下男朋友。

s: after you wash them.
e: 洗完手後，「要把它們弄乾」。(Ａ)(Ｃ)不合常情(Ｄ)前、後二句都是「洗碗盤」，語意不合。

s: Zoey was sleepwalking 　　　.
o: when a sound（聲音）wakes her up
when I walk past her room
e: (Ａ)時式只須是「過去簡單式」sleepwalked(Ｂ)(Ｄ)動詞須分別改成　woke / walked。

s: I could not speak or move when a black dog was standing in front of me.
o: He could see me in the dark.
e: 當一個黑色的狗正站在我面前時，我無法說話或者移動一下。「誰可以幫助我？」

s: I looked at the clock, and it was 　　　.  A new day just started.
e: 是「12：01」，才是新的一天剛剛開始。

s: My grandma is an early bird.  　　　  Before breakfast, she does some exercise at the park every day.
o: She sleeps in（睡懶覺；晚起床）.
She gets up at a quarter to six.
She goes to bed early, but she gets up late.
She goes to bed and gets up late.
e: 早起者，「在差　1　刻鐘到　6　點起床。」較合理。

s: The girl couldn’t sleep last night because 　　　.
o: she heard someone crying out of the window of her bedroom
e: 女孩昨晚無法睡覺因為「她聽到她臥室窗外有人在哭」。

s: A sound（聲音）outside（在…的外面）the house woke me up at 3:50 a.m., and 　　　.
o: I couldn’t fall asleep again after that
I sit up and look at it
I could hear it in my dream
e: 屋外的聲音在早上　3：50　弄醒我，而「在那之後我就無法再睡著了」。

s: Look!  There’s some water on the floor.
o: Let’s swim in it right now.
Let’s clean it up with a mop.
We’re busy moving things into our new place.
e: 地板上有一些水。「讓我們用拖把把它清乾淨。」。

s: I wasn’t playing basketball on the court（球場）at that time because 　　　.
o: I did take out the clothes and hang them
I’m sweeping and mopping the floor
I’m scared of that big ball
it was raining cats and dogs
e: 那時我沒在球場打籃球因為「正在下傾盆大雨」。(Ｂ)(Ｃ)　I’m　須改成　I was。

s: Jim and I were watching TV 　　　.
o: when Dad left for his office
because we do not have any homework to do
because our favorite show is playing
e: 「當爸爸動身前往他的辦公室時，」Jim 和我正在看電視。(Ｃ)　do　至少須改成　did(Ｄ)　is　須改成　was。

s: A black shape（形狀）was standing next to my bed when I opened my eyes at 3:10 a.m.  He wanted to do something bad to me, but luckily, my dad came into my room in time（及時）.
o: Maybe I was drawing my pet dog.
I could not fall asleep in the dark.
However, I could not have a good night’s sleep.
e: 當我凌晨　3：10　睜開眼睛時，一個黑色模糊的身影正站在我床邊。他想對我做出不好的事，但是幸好我爸爸及時進來我房間。「多麼可怕的經歷啊！」(Ｂ)並非在畫圖(Ｄ)整晚沒睡好，是較自然的傾向，語氣並沒轉折。

p:
克漏字測驗
Nadia: You look very tired today, Vlad. What happened?
　Vlad: I had a terrible dream last night, and I couldn’t fall asleep again.
Nadia: Poor you. What time did you wake up from the dream?
　Vlad: At about 　(1)　.
Nadia: 3:45 a.m.? That was in the middle of the night! What was your dream about?
　Vlad: Well, in my dream, I 　(2)　 the clothes in the yard. Suddenly, a big black dog ran after me. I was very scared, so I ran back into the house.
Nadia: And then?
　Vlad: Then I saw my brother, Peter. He was mopping the stairs. I cried for help, but he just looked at me and said nothing. I 　(3)　 when the dog jumped on me! Then I woke up.
Nadia: That sounds terrible. Maybe you are just nervous about your math test the next day.
　Vlad: Maybe. I am really worried about it.
Nadia: 　(4)　 You studied hard for days. You will be fine. Oh, maybe you can hang a dreamcatcher by your bed. The web catches bad dreams, but the good ones go through the holes.
　Vlad: Thanks for the tip. I’ll try it tonight. Time to go to bed early!
e: 由下一句　Nadia　驚呼的時間可知　Vlad　是在三點四十五分醒來，距離四點還差　15　分鐘，逆讀法為　a quarter to four，故選(Ａ)。(Ｂ)　3：15(Ｃ)　3：30(Ｄ)　3：15。
k: 克漏字—文意題組：理解文章(圖、表)並推論。

s: (１)How many hours of sleep should school kids get every night?
p:
(Ken, a thirteen-year-old student, is watching news on TV.)
　　Do you want to do well on your tests? Sleeping more helps you at school. Scientists say children age from 7 to 12 need ten hours of sleep every night. Adults only need 7 or 8 hours of sleep, but kids need to sleep more to learn and remember new things at school.
　　If you learned something, and you just couldn’t remember it, maybe you need more sleep. Just follow the three things, and then you can do well on the tests.
1. Exercise! Sitting all day is bad for your brain, your heart, and the body. To exercise every day helps you sleep well.
2. Don’t watch TV or play with your cellphone at night!
　The light of the TV or your phone tells the body to wake up. And that’s not good before bedtime.
3. Hit the sack at the same time every night.
　If you go to sleep at 8:00 one night and at 10:00 the next night, your body gets confused. Your brain says, “Hey! Should I feel tired now?” Or maybe it’s saying, “Ahhhh! I’m tired. Help!”
　　So, remember the magic number: 10. You need to sleep for ten hours and follow the three things.
e: 由Scientists say children age from 7 to 12 need ten hours of sleep every night.　可知學齡兒童每天需要十小時睡眠。

s: (１)What does it mean in the second line?
p:
Day of the Dead
　　People from different countries see death in different ways. In Taiwan, we seldom talk about it even on Tomb Sweeping Day. In Mexico, people celebrate Day of the Dead with joy. It is a national holiday and lasts for many days.
　　During the festival, family and friends get together to pray for their dead family and offer food and drinks for them, too. People are not sad or scared of the dead.
